title: TicTacToe Extras: Seeded Random Start and Invalid-Move Retry
instructions: The lesson's game code is provided in `tictactoe/game.py` (read-only). In `tictactoe/extras.py` implement `SeededBuilder` (a `Game.Builder` that keeps all validation, then rotates the player list by an offset drawn from the injected `random.Random`) and `RetryingController` (`start_game_seeded` and `play`, which re-asks the same player after an `InvalidMoveError` and raises `TooManyInvalidMovesError` once consecutive invalid moves exceed `max_invalid_moves`). Do not change the `Game` rules.

evidence.label: The same seed gives the same starter and every player still takes part
Both players can be the starter for some seed
The order is a rotation of the original: A, B, C becomes ABC, BCA or CAB
SeededBuilder still raises InvalidGameConfigError for a bad configuration
An invalid move is retried by the same player and the game finishes
The consecutive-invalid counter resets after any valid move
Too many consecutive invalid moves raises TooManyInvalidMovesError and leaves the game untouched
The raised error hides the original InvalidMoveError chain
play() drives a full game to a draw
play() on a finished game makes no further moves
